items.headline: [D] ICML 2026: Policy A vs Policy B impact on scores discussion
items.summary: I am curious whether others observed the same thing. At ICML 2026, papers could be reviewed under two LLM-review policies: a stricter one where reviewers were not supposed to use LLMs, and a more permissive one where limited LLM assistance was allowed. I chose Policy A for my paper. items.headline: Detection of local geometry in random graphs: information-theoretic and computational limits
items.summary:
arXiv:2603.24545v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: We study the problem of detecting local geometry in random graphs.
